name: internal_commit
description: One record per committed transaction, carrying everything a consumer needs to rebuild the transaction's metadata and the post state of the accounts it wrote

bank_seq.description: Bank sequence number of the bank the transaction committed on; the join key to the bank the consumer tracks

index_in_slot.description: 0-indexed position of this transaction within its block

commit_index_in_slot.description: 0-indexed commit-completion order within this slot; orders account writes of the same slot

is_leader.description: True if the bank is a block this validator is producing

is_simple_vote.description: True if the transaction was classified as a simple vote

is_fees_only.description: True if the transaction landed but only fees were charged

logs_truncated.description: True if the log collector dropped messages past its limit

accounts_included.description: True if touched lists every account the transaction wrote and an account record follows for each; false when account reporting is off

txn_err.description: Firedancer transaction error code, 0 on success

exec_err.description: Firedancer instruction error code, meaningful when txn_err is the instruction error

exec_err_idx.description: Index of the instruction that failed, UINT_MAX if not applicable

custom_err.description: Custom error code returned by the program, UINT_MAX if not applicable

rent_err_account_idx.description: Account index the rent state check rejected, UINT_MAX if not applicable

execution_fee.description: Execution (base) fee charged to the fee payer

priority_fee.description: Priority fee charged to the fee payer

compute_unit_limit.description: Compute unit limit of the transaction

acct_addr_cnt.description: Number of leading keys entries that come from the transaction message itself; the rest are loaded from address lookup tables

adtl_writable_cnt.description: Number of keys entries after the first acct_addr_cnt that are writable; the remainder are the readonly loaded addresses

return_data_program_id.description: Program that set the return data, all zero if none did

keys.description: Account keys of the transaction, in message order followed by the writable and then the readonly loaded addresses

pre_lamports.description: Lamport balance of each key before the transaction, in keys order

post_lamports.description: Lamport balance of each key after the transaction, in keys order

is_writable.description: Whether each key was locked writable, in keys order

logs.description: Log collector buffer as it stands at commit: each message is a protobuf tagged, length prefixed record

trace.description: Instructions in execution order, top level and inner

program_id_idx.description: Index into keys of the program that ran

stack_height.description: Instruction stack height, 1 for a top level instruction

acct_cnt.description: Number of trace_accts entries this instruction owns

acct_off.description: Offset of this instruction's first entry in trace_accts

data_off.description: Offset of this instruction's data in trace_data

trace_accts.description: Account indices of every instruction in trace, concatenated in trace order

trace_data.description: Instruction data of every instruction in trace, concatenated in trace order

return_data.description: Return data the transaction left behind

touched.description: Every account the transaction wrote, in the order their account records follow this one on the link, empty unless accounts_included; the post state itself travels in those records

element.description: Post state of one written account

key_idx.description: Index into keys of the account written

executable.description: 1 if the post state is executable

lamports.description: Post state lamports; 0 means the account was closed

data_sz.description: Size of the post state data
